translations.overview: Durante un viaggio in Europa assieme al fedele manager, la star del cinema Jay Kelly affronta il proprio passato e presente in questo film dal candidato agli Oscar® Noah Baumbach.
Famous movie actor Jay Kelly embarks on a journey of self-discovery, confronting both his past and present, accompanied by his devoted manager, Ron.
translations.tagline: Everybody knows Jay Kelly, but Jay Kelly doesn't know himself.
